note: Decision 331 (owner, 2026-11-15): official work. A job never quite pays for a normal life — it slows the Credit Score's bleed, nothing more (the bare minimum to stay in the system is ~7 CRS a month). Pay per month of downtime, by career family; Gig work anyone can take (half pay, no trust); trust builds with unbroken in-world months on the books. Debts take a share of the cash wage (`garnish`, a debt may set its own). Numbers are the owner's to tune.
